lines.trans: Right, Petukhov, go stand in the corner right now!
Stop misbehaving and bothering the other children.
May I take this pretty toy car?
Of course, Lyosha, take any toy you like!
Play calmly and do not be afraid of anyone.
Thank you very much, I will build a big garage.
And afterwards we will go to have lunch.
Today in the kitchen they cooked delicious soup.
I like hot soup very much!
Eat well so that you grow up strong.
Thank you for your care, Anna Ivanovna!
Well done, Lyosha, you are our best boy.
